critical_path: Hard dependency: Telemetry Data Validation must complete before Funnel Step Mapping begins. Hard dependency: Session Coding completion blocks Persona Behavior Mapping. Hard dependency: Survey Data Cleaning completion blocks Segment Definition Validation. Soft dependency: Design Synthesis can begin once all evidence is integrated, but may delay if survey skew correction is not finalized. Critical path sequence: Phase 1 → Phase 2 → Phase 3 → Phase 4 → Phase 5. Duration: 68 days (Phase 1: 14 days; Phase 2: 20 days; Phase 3: 17 days; Phase 4: 17 days; Phase 5: 10 days). Derived date for Phase 1 start: 2023-10-01. Slip threshold: if any phase exceeds its duration by more than 5 days, the critical path must be recomputed.
decision_log: Decision: Redesign first step to include a guided walkthrough instead of a blank canvas. Evidence line: 72% of participants in moderated sessions reported confusion at step 1, with verbatim: 'I didn’t know what to do next.' Risk if assumption wrong: If users still struggle after the walkthrough, drop-off at step 1 may remain high despite intervention. Decision: Remove step 5 as a mandatory task; replace with optional template. Evidence line: 48% of survey respondents in the 'new user' segment said they skipped step 5 due to perceived irrelevance. Risk if assumption wrong: If users skip step 5 and fail to adopt templates, first value delivery may be delayed by up to 2 days. Decision: Introduce a progress indicator at step 4; based on telemetry showing 30% of users abandon after step 4 without feedback. Evidence line: Telemetry shows 30% drop-off at step 4 with no progress feedback. Risk if assumption wrong: If the indicator fails to reduce abandonment, funnel loss remains unaddressed. Decision: Final design includes a guided walkthrough and optional template; progress indicator is implemented in version 2.1. Evidence line: All evidence from telemetry, moderated sessions, and survey supports this path. Risk if assumption wrong: If users perceive the walkthrough as intrusive, adoption may decline by up to 15% — monitored via post-launch telemetry. Checkpoint for regression: Post-launch telemetry must show drop-off at step 4 reduced by at least 20%; check lives in Product Analytics dashboard under 'onboarding funnel v2.1'.
